title: Romper a: Breaking Into Sound and Tears
goal: Use romper a + infinitive for the moment when sound, tears or rain break a silence.
grammar: romper a + infinitive: sounds and feelings that burst out

items: I can use *romper a* + infinitive for sounds, tears and rain that burst out.
I can choose between *romper a*, *echarse a* and *ponerse a*.
I can use the new words for sudden noise and joy.
